thread:
Nora (PM): Quick thread to define the DP concierge incentives and retention hooks. want something repeatable and measurable — low friction for partners, clear ops limits.
Ellen (Customer Success): propose a 3-part incentive: 1) $250 credit after onboarding tasks, 2) $500 milestone credit after 2 weeks active usage, 3) leaderboard perks (early access) for top signal partners. keep payments simple.
Rafi (Sales Eng): agree on credits. need explicit eligibility: completed onboarding + at least 10 "meaningful sessions" or 500 tokens/day for 7 days. otherwise prorate.
Kai (Research): measurement: define "meaningful session" = task run that completes canonical prompt set and submits survey. we'll auto-tag these. also need sampling for qualitative interviews (~20% of partners).
Tess (Design): partner experience: make incentive language friendly and transparent. quick FAQ snippet: "You keep credits even if you drop out; we'll follow up for feedback." I'll push a template. :memo:
Nora (PM): ops constraints: budget cap per cohort = $10k credits + $1k ad-hoc (swag/consult). Can we make standby credits reserved?
Ellen (Customer Success): standby pool ok. also suggest a soft opt-in for extra 1:1 research calls (compensated $100). keeps churn low.
Rafi (Sales Eng): legal check: need standard consent and data use blurb in invite. include opt-out for logs sharing. will coordinate with SOC.
Kai (Research): success metrics for retention: 1) 40% of partners reach milestone 2 by week 3, 2) median session count >= 8/week, 3) NPS >= 7 at week 2. if metrics below baseline, escalate.
Nora (PM): escalation path: first triage in #dp-live within 30m, then on-call Eng + CS ping. Rollback only if platform regressions > threshold.
OncallBot: Monitoring hooks: eval-delta, structured-output-errors, partner-drop-rate. Alert: drop-rate > 30% in 24h -> page on-call.
Tess (Design): comms snippet for invite email:```text
Hi — thanks for joining our DP cohort! Earn $250 credit after setup, and another $500 after two weeks of active use. We'll ask for short surveys and optional 1:1s. Full details: https://redwood.docs/dp-incentives
```
Ellen (Customer Success): logistics: payout flow = credits applied to account within 7 days of milestone verification. physical swag handled separately.
Rafi (Sales Eng): I'll draft eligibility rules + consent lines and share by Wed.
Kai (Research): I'll produce the instrumentation checklist (auto-tag, survey hooks, interview sampling) and a quick smoke test for partner signals by Thu.
Nora (PM): owners: Rafi = legal/eligibility, Kai = measurement, Tess = partner comms, Ellen = payout ops, Nora = cohort budget. Kickoff meeting Wed 11am PT.
Tess (Design): will add FAQ and opt-out wording.
Ellen (Customer Success): will draft the payout SOP and CSV template.
OncallBot: Calendar event created: "DP Concierge Incentives + Retention Kickoff" Wed 11:00 PT.
Nora (PM): Great. small, repeatable program with clear triggers and owners. follow-up doc in #dp-playbooks. :white_check_mark:
Rafi (Sales Eng): ack.
Kai (Research): ack.
Tess (Design): ack.
